note: Structured mirror of the MGD/CRC north-star metric doctrine defined in docs/field-notes/2026-07-05-groq-ross-dominant-game-recipe.md §3 (the dominant game DWS plays). Machine-readable reflection only, not a reinterpretation — if this file and the field note disagree, the field note §3 wins. Lets scripts/lint-truth-claims.mjs / truth-check FAIL the acquisition/activity anti-metrics (the §2 games DWS refuses to play) in public-layer copy and suggest the dominant-game phrasing (MGD / CRC) instead. The metric definitions below are copied verbatim from field note §3. The flat deprecatedDisplayPhrases array is the lint-consumed aggregate of the per-game phrases in deprecatedGames[], seeded from the field note §2 anti-games table. Registered in DWS_TRUTH_STANDARD.md §2 row 29.

primary.name: Monthly Governed Decisions
primary.definition: A decision counts only when it (a) flows through the governed outcome layer, (b) carries full Article 12 reasoning lineage, and (c) is audit-grade (would survive regulator or internal-audit scrutiny). Pilots, demos, and ungoverned agent runs do not count — exactly as MySpace's dormant accounts did not count for Facebook.

secondary.name: Customer-Retained Capital
secondary.definition: The 4P assets (ontology, skills, calibrated Control Room thresholds, evaluated datasets) the customer owns after the engagement. This is the anti-Karp metric: proof DWS's game is capital formation, not extraction.
